entries.subject: Published TESS phase curves as a map of longitude (Wong et al. 2021; Singh et al. 2024)
entries.finding: Read on 2026-10-08. Wong et al. (2021, arXiv:2106.02610) fit the TESS sector 14 curve (A_atm 43 +13/-11 ppm, D_d 111 +35/-36 ppm, D_n 18 +36/-33 ppm) and print no brightness temperature for this planet. Singh et al. (2024, arXiv:2311.03264) fit TESS with a Lambertian reflected-light phase function, which is not a sinusoid the reader takes, and give the night side only as an upper limit (2280 K).
entries.revisitWhen: A paper prints day-side and night-side brightness temperatures from a sinusoid fit of one band.
